title: Researchers used Claude Opus 5 to hack OpenAI staff ChatGPT and Codex accounts
summary: A three-person Hacktron team used Claude Opus 5 to chain vulnerabilities from an OpenAI forum image upload to logged-in access to OpenAI employee accounts (white-hat disclosure).
